raceTemplates.name: System Design: Distributed URL Shortener
raceTemplates.description: Design a highly available URL shortening service handling 100M URLs/month.

tasks.name: Requirements & Scope
tasks.notes: Functional (shorten, redirect) & non-functional (latency, 99.99% availability).

tasks.name: Capacity & Traffic Estimations
tasks.notes: Calculate write QPS (100/s), read QPS (10,000/s), storage for 5 years.

tasks.name: High-Level Architecture & API
tasks.notes: API endpoints, Base62 encoding vs token server, database schema.

tasks.name: Deep Dive: Storage & Caching Layer
tasks.notes: NoSQL KV store vs relational, Redis cache with LRU eviction.

tasks.name: Resilience, Bottlenecks & Partitions
tasks.notes: Replication, rate limiting, DDoS mitigation, analytics pipeline.

raceTemplates.name: Google L5 Coding & Algorithms Practice
raceTemplates.description: Structured technical coding interview simulation under tight 65-minute constraints.

tasks.name: Problem Understanding & Questioning
tasks.notes: Clarify inputs, expected outputs, constraints, and edge cases.

tasks.name: Clarify Edge Cases & Scale
tasks.notes: Discuss memory constraints, large N, empty inputs, duplicate keys.

tasks.name: Algorithmic Strategy & Architecture
tasks.notes: Explain brute-force baseline, then optimal data structure (Hash map, Heap, or DP).

tasks.name: Production-Quality Implementation
tasks.notes: Write clean, idiomatic code with helper functions and descriptive naming.

tasks.name: Dry Run & Edge Case Validation
tasks.notes: Step line-by-line with small example, empty input, and boundary values.

tasks.name: Complexity Analysis & Wrap-up
tasks.notes: State Big-O time and auxiliary space tradeoffs.
